parts.name: Compact differential carrier
parts.description: Local administrator workflow example. Requirements copied from a synthetic carrier template for demonstration only.

revision.changeNote: Synthetic revision example: bearing bore nominal changed from 68.000 to 68.010 mm.

operation.name: Finish machining
operation.setup: Synthetic example: locate on bearing axis B and seat the finished mounting face on datum A.

references.notes: synthetic-visual-pack:v1: local synthetic operation sketch and measurement-setup diagram. Illustrative geometry, not to scale; not a controlled manufacturing drawing.

features.label: Bearing journal bore
features.instruction: Measure the bearing bore at two axial planes and perpendicular orientations, clear of the entry chamfer. Verify every required reading.

features.label: Ring-gear locating pilot
features.instruction: Measure the cylindrical locating pilot about datum axis B, clear of the shoulder radius.

features.label: Ring-gear face runout
features.instruction: Locate the carrier on datum axis B. Sweep the mounting face through one revolution and record total indicator reading, not a single height.

features.label: Differential cross-pin bore
features.instruction: Inspect the cross-pin bore in both accessible windows. Verify its size independently from its location to the bearing axis.

features.label: Bearing shoulder span
features.instruction: Measure between the two finished bearing shoulder planes along the primary axis. Avoid casting and corner reliefs.

features.label: Ring-gear bolt circle
features.instruction: Fit the approved bolt-hole pattern about axis B. Report the pitch-circle diameter; hole size and positional error are separate characteristics.

features.label: M10 mounting thread full-form depth
features.instruction: Synthetic example: M10 × 1.5-6H, 18.000 mm minimum full-form thread depth from datum A. Use the approved thread-depth GO gage and its calibrated entry-face/first-full-thread correction. Compare the indicated full-form thread plane with this requirement; the gage lead and the drilled-hole floor are different references. Use light hand engagement, keep the hole clean, and never force the gage against the blind-hole bottom. A random screw, overall gage-tip travel, or an assumed number of turns does not establish this depth. Thread size acceptance and NO-GO checks follow the separate approved inspection procedure.

features.label: Window ligament thickness
features.instruction: Check the minimum ligament at the indicated carrier window. Record the lowest required reading, with the approved access method.
